T.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Based on Article 31, Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021. Not legal advice. Consult MOHRE or a qualified legal professional.
T.warnProbation: No paid sick leave entitlement during probation. Employer may grant unpaid leave on submission of a medical report.
T.warnExceeds: Warning: Total sick days exceed the 90-day annual maximum. Excess absence may be treated as unauthorized absence.
T.warnInjury: Note: Work-related injuries are subject to different rules under UAE law. Contact MOHRE for guidance.
T.noteReport: You must notify your employer within 3 business days and submit an approved medical report.
T.matNote: Maternity leave is 45 days at full pay + 15 days at half pay. Leave may begin up to 4 weeks before the expected birth date.
T.matExtra: Additional unpaid leave (up to 45 days) is available for pregnancy/childbirth-related illness.
